rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for both an immediate gut feeling and an intuitive insight.

example.english: My intuition tells me that there’s something wrong with this contract.
example.traditional: 我嘅直覺話畀我知，呢份合約有啲問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 zik6 gok3 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 di1 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when intuition is presented as a mysterious or instinctive sixth sense, not for ordinary perceptive insight.

example.english: My intuition tells me that he isn’t a good person.
example.traditional: 我第六感覺得佢唔係好人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 luk6 gam2 gok3 dak1 keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 jan4
